# aether_organization_members (Data Source)

Every membership of the provider's organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The memberships, in the API's order (by membership id). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `accepted_at` (String) Time the invitation was accepted (RFC 3339); null when not recorded.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the membership (RFC 3339).
- `email` (String) Login email address of the member.
- `id` (String) Membership UUID (not a user id).
- `invited_by` (String) UUID of the user who invited the member; null when not recorded (always for memberships created through the API).
- `role` (String) `owner`, `admin`, `member` or `viewer`.
